messages:
lisa: hey team — ACME deal update: they want a committed plan (monthly) with a POC first. ask: what reserved GPUs should we propose for a 300 QPS steady profile with 2x daily 10m bursts up to 1200 QPS? also need autoscale policy template + cost estimator. can we sync? :thinking:
raj: quick q — what's their 95/99 latency SLO? and avg tokens per request?
elisa: (from customer) aiming for p99 < 200ms and ~120 tokens per request on generation calls. embeddings small batch QPS separate (~50 qps).
raj: ok, helpful. rough back-of-envelope: if a single A100-ish GPU can sustain ~600 RPS for 120-token gen with our quantized model variant (prod profile), then steady 300 QPS = 0.5 GPU baseline. but we don't sell half-GPUs so recommend reserve 1 GPU baseline + burst capacity.
sam: +1 to raj's calc. for commits we usually recommend baseline = ceil(steady / per-GPU-throughput) and a burst buffer of 1-2 GPUs depending on risk appetite. for 2x daily bursts to 1200 QPS, that's ~2 GPUs extra if each GPU handles 600 RPS, so reserve plan: 3 GPUs (1 baseline + 2 burst) OR 2 reserved + burst credits for the rest.
raj: if they want guaranteed p99 during bursts, reserve 3. if they're ok with graceful degradation (fall back to smaller model / async queue), reserve 2 and enable burst credits/autoscale.
emily: we should also surface the autoscale policy template and billing implications. billing note: reserved GPUs billed monthly; burst credits billed on use or as part of a burst allowance in the contract. customer care: do they want preheat / KV cache warmup for the POC?
lisa: they'll want preheat to avoid cold-start tail latencies; put that in the POC runbook. also security team asked to confirm that private model routing will be used for PHI handling — i'll attach the questionnaire separately.
sam: autoscale policy stub (copyable):
```
min_replicas: 1
max_replicas: 5
reserve_pool: 2  # GPUs kept for bursts, billed as credits if not reserved
scale_metric: token_rate
scale_step: 1
preheat_window: 90s
fallback_policy: route_to_smaller_model_then_queue
```
raj: for cost estimator, quick calc snippet:
```
steady_qps = 300
tokens_per_req = 120
tokens_per_sec = steady_qps * tokens_per_req
gpu_tokens_per_sec = 600 * 120  # approx throughput per GPU in tokens/sec (model/profile dependent)
required_gpus = ceil(tokens_per_sec / gpu_tokens_per_sec)
```
lisa: can you translate that to monthly numbers with ACME's expected utilization? they expect 65% avg utilization, 2-week ramp in POC then monthly commit.
sam: rough monthly table:
- reserve 2 GPUs: monthly cost = $X (reserved) + burst credits used for peak windows (~estimated 40 hours/month) => +$Y
- reserve 3 GPUs: monthly cost = $X+delta, near-zero burst billing, simpler SLA
I'll run exact numbers with finance if you want.
raj: ops note: add an availability zone fallback in rollout plan. if AZ failure, route to another region's reserved pool (with traffic-shift canary).
emily: POC checklist additions: security questionnaire signed, preheat runbook, KV cache seed steps, test harness with synthetic 120-token traces, billing/commit signoff.
lisa: thanks — can we meet tomorrow 10am PT to finalize the recommendation and produce a one-pager for legal/finance? I'll invite ACME SEs.
raj: works for me.
sam: good for me.
nora-bot: reminder: attach the latest commit pricing matrix and the autoscale JSON template to this thread after the sync. :robot_face:
lisa: perfect — i'll collect customer answers to security Qs and send sample load profiles before the meeting. thanks all :rocket:
